name: Sliding Statue (1-2)

source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy

disable: DC 20 Athletics check to hold it back, DC 17 Crafting check (trained) to break the statue by exploiting a flaw, DC 16 Occultism check (trained) to dispel the planar energies.
routine: (3 actions) The trap uses its three actions for its Trample activity.

items.name: Slide
items.text:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the trap.

---

Effect The statue Strides up to 30 feet in the direction of the triggering creature. It deals 1d6+3 untyped damage (DC 17 basic Reflex save save) to each creature whose space it enters.

items.name: Trample
items.text:
Medium or smaller, crushing feet DC 17 basic Reflex save

---

text: With a rumble, this statue of a former Pathfinder slides across the schoolyard. Its legs pump up and down as it advances.
